use default
use System.Math

root_mean_square(values: Collections.List[double]) -> double is
    let squares =
        values
            |> map(v => v * v)
            |> reduce(0.0, (running, square) => running + square)

    return Math.sqrt(squares / cast(values.count))
si

let one_to_ten = (1::10) |> map(n => cast double(n)) |> collect()

write_line("{root_mean_square(one_to_ten)}")
